name: Longbow bolt-action rifle
teaser: Bolt-action rifle from COD2023 that satisfy (or annoy) both AK and bolt-action fans.
description_html:
with 2 versions of dust cover, 4 types of barrel, 3 types of bolts and 2 types of handguard modification included.

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_Longbow folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find them in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Models and textures are properties of Actvision;
